sounds.name: kick-soft
sounds.purpose: A pass or a soft touch
sounds.prompt: Single soft football pass, side of boot on a leather ball, short thud on grass.

sounds.name: kick-hard
sounds.prompt: Single powerful football shot, boot smashing a leather ball, sharp punchy thump.

sounds.name: goal-net
sounds.purpose: Ball hits the back of the net
sounds.prompt: Football ball hitting the back of a goal net, rope net ripple and rustle, short.

sounds.name: crowd-cheer-small
sounds.purpose: Goal at a small non-league ground
sounds.prompt: Small crowd of a few hundred at a non-league football ground cheering a goal, claps and shouts, short.

sounds.name: crowd-cheer-stadium
sounds.prompt: Huge football stadium crowd erupting for a goal, roar swelling then fading, short.

sounds.name: crowd-groan
sounds.purpose: A near miss or a save
sounds.prompt: Football stadium crowd groaning 'ohhh' after a near miss, short.

sounds.name: keeper-save
sounds.prompt: Goalkeeper gloves catching a football hard, padded leather slap thud.

sounds.name: whistle-start
sounds.prompt: Referee whistle, one short sharp blast.

sounds.name: whistle-half
sounds.prompt: Referee whistle, two short blasts.

sounds.name: whistle-full
sounds.prompt: Referee whistle, three blasts, the last one long.

sounds.name: ui-tap
sounds.prompt: Tiny soft UI tap click for a mobile game menu.

sounds.name: ui-confirm
sounds.prompt: Short bright positive mobile game UI confirm blip, two rising notes.

sounds.name: coin-in
sounds.prompt: Getting paid: a quick rustle of paper banknotes being counted out, then a cash register drawer opening with a bright ka-ching. Money, not a single coin.

sounds.name: star-tick
sounds.prompt: Bright satisfying magical star sparkle chime, a shimmering twinkle with a clear bell ping, mobile game reward, full and rich not tiny.

sounds.name: level-up
sounds.prompt: Triumphant short mobile game level-up sting, rising shimmer and chime.

sounds.name: achievement-pop
sounds.prompt: Big satisfying achievement unlocked fanfare: a punchy pop, a bright rising chime arpeggio and a sparkling shimmer tail, celebratory mobile game reward.

sounds.name: breaking-news
sounds.prompt: Short TV sports news breaking-news sting, dramatic whoosh and hit.

sounds.name: phone-notification
sounds.purpose: New post on the phone feed
sounds.prompt: Smartphone notification ping, clean two-tone chime.

sounds.name: can-open
sounds.prompt: Aluminium drink can cracking open with a fizz hiss.

sounds.name: comm-goal-1
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) Goal!

sounds.name: comm-goal-2
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) What a finish!

sounds.name: comm-goal-3
sounds.purpose: Commentator: It's in! What a goal!
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) It's in! What a goal!

sounds.name: comm-goal-4
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) He scores!

sounds.name: comm-goal-5
sounds.purpose: Commentator: Into the back of the net!
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) Into the back of the net!

sounds.name: comm-goal-6
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) Oh, that is brilliant!

sounds.name: comm-replay-1
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) Let's see that again.

sounds.name: comm-replay-2
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) Look at the finish.

sounds.name: comm-replay-3
sounds.purpose: Commentator: Have another look at this.
sounds.prompt: (Offline voice, Piper en-gb 'alan'.) Have another look at this.
